messages:
priya_csm: Hi all  kicking off Quartz activation. Goal: pilot hosted convo + retrieval, decide Dedicated after pilot. Proposed kickoff Thu 11/9 9am PT. Agenda: intro, success criteria, access (SSO/API keys), sanitized data handoff, infra sizing, enablement plan, procurement/legal risks. Who can make it?

jules_cs: I can run enablement & post-pilot survey. 9am PT works.

quartz_pm: PM + infra lead available. We'll upload a redacted dataset (ndjson) and top prompts list by Tue. Procurement asked for a ballpark estimate early.

marco_se: Ill own SSO + ingestion flow. Need sample + example user journeys. Also please confirm log retention and PII masking expectations.

hana_eng: I can scope Dedicated fallback and bench. Will run perf tests once sample is up; propose starting with 1 GPU-equivalent for pilot.

riley_successops: Draft success criteria: 
- Staging: top 5 user journeys pass end-to-end
- Demo: PM + CS lead accept pilot use-case
- Latency: p50 <300ms OR documented tradeoff with cost
- Security: retention & masking sign-off from legal
- Handback: runbook + incident owner assigned

priya_csm: Quick timeline idea: Week0 kickoff, Week1 access + sample, Week2 integration + enablement, Week3 pilot + feedback, Week4 demo & go/no-go, Week5 handoff.

quartz_pm: Legal will want a short retention note before we push sample to staging. Legal contact: legal@quartz.example.

marco_se: Requesting Quartz provide IP ranges for allowlist and a service account for uploads. Note: infra needs 48h lead for allowlist changes.

hana_eng: Will post bench numbers and token-cost estimate in the kickoff doc by Wed after sample arrives.

riley_successops: Feedback plan: 3-question pulse after pilot + 20-min follow-up interview. Ill draft.

priya_csm: Action owners: jules_cs create kickoff doc + invite; quartz_pm upload sample + procurement contact; marco_se SSO checklist + ingestion plan; hana_eng bench + smoke tests; riley_successops success criteria + survey; priya_csm risk register + 30/60 health checks.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Thu Nov 9 9:00am PT "Quartz: Redwood Activation Kickoff"  invites sent. Link: https://meet.redwood/quartz-kickoff

legal-bot: Reminder: Please attach data retention summary to kickoff doc for faster review.

priya_csm: Great  add any constraints here (procurement lead times, legal review windows) and we'll adjust. See you Thu.
